curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach drugs and pills, then mixing, then how alcohol moves and impairs, then drink equivalence, then marijuana and other drugs
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on pills, mixes, judgment first, equal servings and marijuana at any level
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what impairs, what mixing does, the death share, equal drinks and medical marijuana

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the low-level impairment penalty, then implied consent and refusals, then officer observations and what DUI means
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on the fine range, consent, refusals, point-oh-eight and officer eyes
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on the low-level fine, what refusal does, whether a conviction is needed and what DUI spans

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the conviction-notice ladder, then DUI jail and fines, then DUI revocations, then the lifelong costs
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on each ladder step, first-offense penalties, the ten-year window and costs
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on notice suspensions, first DUI penalties, revocation lengths and arrest costs

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach what breaks zero tolerance and the revocations, then youth fines, swaps and court reports
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on any measurable amount, six and twelve months, fines and reports
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what breaks zero tolerance, the first revocation, fine swaps and what courts report
